curated_entries.title: Reconstructing a typed bipartite graph from its incidence-deletion deck
curated_entries.intuition: Let `G` and `H` use the same finite bipartition. If `G` remains connected after deleting any vertex, its vertex types are pairwise distinct, and the two incidence-deletion decks agree, then a bijection preserving the two parts also preserves every edge. Thus the deck determines `G` up to bipartite isomorphism under these strong distinguishability hypotheses.
